subject: QBR surgical playbook: account-by-account summaries + forecast consolidation
messages:
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: 2026-11-16T08:12:00-08:00
Subject: QBR surgical playbook: account-by-account summaries + forecast consolidation

Team —

We need a tightly scoped deliverable for the upcoming QBR readout: a one‑page account summary for each named opportunity + a single-line recommended ask (commit/close/landscape). Goal is to surface runway risk, next milestones, blockers, and a conservative forecast reconciliation that maps back to our SFDC deal stages.

Please use the attached "runway_playbook_template.xlsx" and follow the attached guideline PDF for the format. Key constraints:
- Keep each account summary to one page (use the template).
- Provide conservative and optimistic ARR numbers and the primary blocker (compliance, procurement, budget, integration).
- Tag any accounts needing leadership escalation.

Deliverables and deadlines:
1) Account-by-account files uploaded to the shared Drive folder (see link) by EOD Tuesday 11/17.
2) Consolidated forecast spreadsheet (qbr_forecast_rollup_v1.xlsx) populated with conservative numbers by EOD Wednesday 11/18.

Owners: field sellers own the account pages; sales ops will do the rollup but need clean inputs. Tessa — can you coordinate the Drive/HubSpot sync? Marcus/Kim — please prioritize the Top 15 named deals (list below). Aditya — please run a quick sanity check on the metadata (tax, region tags) before the rollup.

Top 15 (priority): ACME-Enterprise, BLUE-Cloud-Platform, STORIX-Data, NOVA-Health, OCEAN-Logistics, and 10 more in the template.

I want one highlight slide from each of you (1 slide) that summarizes risk and recommended action for the exec deck.

Thanks — rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Field Sales, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0184
Redwood Inference

Attachments: runway_playbook_template.xlsx (spreadsheet), account_summary_guideline.pdf (pdf)
From: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-16T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: QBR surgical playbook: account-by-account summaries + forecast consolidation

Thanks for the clear ask. I’ll create the Drive folder structure + permissions and paste the HubSpot list (Top 15) into a sheet with a link column back to each account summary. I’ll also add a small checklist per account: owner, primary contact, current stage, forecast conservative/optimistic, next milestone, blocker, escalation flag.

Folks: when you upload, please name files as: [DEALID]_[account_shortname]_QBR2026_v1.pdf (this will help ops script the rollup).

I’ll ping once folders are live (~30m).

—Tessa
Tessa Morgan
VP, Sales Operations
Tessa_morgan@redwood.ai

From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-16T11:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: QBR surgical playbook: account-by-account summaries + forecast consolidation

Rishi / all —

Uploading a quick pass for the Top 5 now (attached inline summary for ACME & BlueCloud). Quick notes:

ACME-Enterprise (DEAL-8342) — conservative ARR: $1.2M, optimistic: $1.65M. Current milestone: security review completed 11/09; next milestone is commercial sig (PO) pending legal T&Cs. Primary blocker: custom data retention clause in legal. Recommended ask: request a 60‑day PO commitment window; escalate legal redline with product security if not resolved in 7 days.

BlueCloud-Platform (BLUE-PLAT) — conservative ARR: $420k, optimistic: $600k. Procurement has asked for a SOC2 audit extract and an Azure Gov deployment option. Procurement engagement ongoing; estimated close Q1 if SOC docs and deployment notes provided. Recommended ask: offer a 6‑month pilot contract with milestone-based payments.

Attachments: ACME_onepager_DEAL-8342.pdf (pdf stub), BlueCloud_onepager_BLUE-PLAT.pdf (pdf stub)

I’ll follow up with the remaining Top 10 by EOD Tuesday.

-marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-16T13:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: QBR surgical playbook: account-by-account summaries + forecast consolidation

Marcus — thanks, this is exactly the level of detail I want. Two follow-ups:

1) For ACME please add the expected procurement owner and a link to the last signed SOW (if available). If legal redline is the blocker, mark the escalation flag HIGH and paste the redline excerpt (one sentence) in the template.

2) For BlueCloud: add the SOC2 artifacts we can share (point to the SecureDocs location) and note whether Azure Gov is a must or preferred.

Aditya — can you start a quick metadata QA pass on the two uploaded one‑pagers (format, tags, and folder naming)? If things look good, ops should be able to ingest the files for the consolidated rollup.

Tessa — once the Top 15 are in, have ops do a first pass rollup and send the consolidated sheet back to this thread for final signoff.

If we hit deadlines, we’ll have time to build the exec highlight deck on Thursday morning. Pushing for crisp and conservative numbers — I’d rather under‑promise and over‑deliver.

-Rishi

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-16T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: QBR surgical playbook: account-by-account summaries + forecast consolidation

Rishi / team —

All Top 15 uploaded to the Drive folder; naming convention followed. I ran the metadata QA pass (Aditya assisted) and fixed stage tags on 3 accounts where reps had left legacy tags.

Consolidated rollup (conservative numbers) attached: qbr_forecast_rollup_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet stub). Notes:
- Total conservative ARR rollup: $6.28M across Top 15.
- Risk buckets: 4 HIGH (legal/procurement), 6 MED, 5 LOW.
- Escalations recommended: ACME (LEGAL), BLUE-PLAT (SOC & GOV), NOVA-Health (integration POC dependency).

I also included direct HubSpot links in column H for quick drilldown. Tessa — folder permissions set to Editor for this group so ops can run the ingestion script.

Next steps:
1) Rishi — please confirm if you want leadership escalation emails drafted by me for the three HIGH-risk deals (I can template them).
2) Marcus / Aditya — please confirm the ACME redline excerpt is correct in the ACME one‑pager.

Kim

Kimberly Park
Director, Sales Operations
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Attachments: qbr_forecast_rollup_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), Top15_folder_index.csv (csv stub)
